_comment: PAD-710 (delivery.android-nightly-lane): where the nightly Android suite is cut into parallel shards. Shard k runs from starts[k] up to the flow before starts[k+1], in config.yaml's flowsOrder. Shards after the first begin with the warm-up flow. A chain is a run of flows that relies on an earlier flow's data; it must stay inside one shard, in this order. Check: scripts/maestro-shards.mjs, pinned by src/lib/maestro-shards.test.ts.
